cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.

mechanism: A corrects what an expedition sponsor actually needs from photographs, using increasing professional specificity to be chosen over Martin.
confusable: Generic self-promotion lacks concrete correction of the selection criteria and deliverable mistakes.
comparison: Birthday alternative competes with an obligation; photographer alternative competes with another professional.
seedUse: Desert/French sponsor/logo seed supplies useful changing requirements; S03 must demonstrate technical judgement while explicitly competing for the role.
